name: Spring Bloom

name: Cherry Blossom Dance

Rewards: Cherry Blossom Kimono, Lover's Pendant, charm of affection

Rewards: Star Metal ore, meteor shard weapon, cosmic dust
Description: A brilliant streak of light crashes to earth. At the impact site, rare materials await.

Effects: Merchant needs escort, hostile mobs block the road, reward scales with danger
Rewards: Merchant's gratitude, gold, rare trade goods, merchant reputation

name: Bard's Tale
Effects: Morale boost in town, inspiration buff (+10% XP for 1 hour), songs learned
Rewards: Lute of Inspiration, Bard's Songbook, morale buff

name: Caravan Ambush
